title: Had fun making this Futbol Island game with suggestions from my son
author: poppinpimples
selftext:
You explore an island walking, biking, moped, and flying around in a jet pack 🤣 There’s no right or wrong way to do things, but there are some paths a player can take. You need to find it all, but everything revolves around learning some aspect of the game of futbol. Through plays, mini quizzes, and interactive stories. 

My son wanted to added card collecting so added that. This will continue to grow as I figure how to keep the heat down on the phone while adding more. Take a spin and let me know if there are things that could make this even better. 

Link here: [futbolisland.app](https://futbolisland.app/)

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Love it. That's the joy AI-enabled game dev. Want a new feature? No problem. Add jet packs? Yeah why not, it's my game. Obviously you could do that before AI but after potentially wasting days, weeks, or months on any given features.
